review.question_for_reviewer: 請核對新舊制度的資格、一般間隔與例外資格重疊時的最短公費間隔，並分別核對繁中與美式英文用語。

variants.question: 以 2024 年 12 月 31 日為準，臺灣一位 36 歲、參加全民健保的民眾到診所詢問國健署公費成人預防保健服務。他沒有不適，從未使用這項服務，沒有小兒麻痺病史。依題示年齡與身分，這項服務最短每隔多久可獲補助？若目前不符合資格，請選對應項目。請說明依據。

options.D: 目前不符合這項服務的補助資格

variants.rationale: 2024 年底一般民眾從 40 歲起符合資格。年滿 35 歲的特別資格適用於具小兒麻痺身分者。本例未符合該條件，當時尚無此項補助。

historical_basis.locator: 慢性疾病防治組，正文第 2 段，成人預防保健服務對象及年度檢查資格。

clinical_update.question: 以 2026 年 11 月 26 日為準，臺灣一位 36 歲、參加全民健保的民眾到診所詢問國健署公費成人預防保健服務。他沒有不適，從未使用這項服務，沒有小兒麻痺病史。依題示年齡與身分，這項服務最短每隔多久可獲補助？若目前不符合資格，請選對應項目。請說明依據。
clinical_update.rationale: 選 C。一般 30 至 39 歲者現在每五年可接受一次，36 歲符合資格。題幹已排除可改為每年一次的小兒麻痺身分。

claims.text: 30 至 39 歲的一般服務間隔為每 5 年一次。
年滿 35 歲且具小兒麻痺身分者，公費方案可每年提供一次成人預防保健服務。
自 2025 年 1 月 1 日起，方案新增 30 至 39 歲的一般民眾。

variants.question: As of December 31, 2024, a 36-year-old adult enrolled in Taiwan’s National Health Insurance asks about the Health Promotion Administration’s publicly funded adult preventive health service. He has no symptoms, has never used this service, and has no history of polio. At his current age, what is the shortest routine interval covered for someone in his eligibility category? If he is currently ineligible, select that option. Explain your answer.

options.D: Not currently eligible for funding under this program

variants.rationale: In December 2024 general eligibility began at age 40. The polio provision for adults age 35 or older did not apply to this patient. He was ineligible at age 36.

historical_basis.locator: 慢性疾病防治組，正文第 2 段，成人預防保健服務對象及年度檢查資格。

clinical_update.question: As of November 26, 2026, a 36-year-old adult enrolled in Taiwan’s National Health Insurance asks about the Health Promotion Administration’s publicly funded adult preventive health service. He has no symptoms, has never used this service, and has no history of polio. At his current age, what is the shortest routine interval covered for someone in his eligibility category? If he is currently ineligible, select that option. Explain your answer.
clinical_update.rationale: C. At age 36 he qualifies under the general provision for ages 30 through 39, which covers one screening every five years. The annual polio provision does not apply.

claims.text: The general interval for adults ages 30 through 39 is once every five years.
People in the program’s polio category qualify annually starting at age 35.
The general eligibility expansion to ages 30 through 39 took effect on January 1, 2025.
